changelog:
Initial release — provides real-time TikTok trend intelligence.

- Monitor trending hashtags, viral music, breakout videos, and top-performing ads in real time.
- Identify high-growth products and market movements before they become mainstream.
- Supports deep-dive research on trends, hashtags, music tracks, products, and ads through multiple API nodes.
- Includes caching mechanism for time-sensitive intelligence and reproducible analysis.
- Designed for brands, creators, and analysts to uncover emerging TikTok opportunities.
